target_abi: Win32 i686 little-endian; 4-byte pointers; 4-byte aggregate alignment

header.note: ObjCounter/TmFrame fields are not authoritative for stage; writer initializes the header and sets MatCounter/MatFilePoint/First_ObjInfoPoint.

pointer_policy.StageArea: 0 for absent, deterministic nonzero sentinel for present; actual lists follow payload
pointer_policy.TexLink: deterministic base token (recommended 0x10000000) when links exist
pointer_policy.other runtime pointers: write 0 unless specifically used as serialized relation token

element_layout_notes.smSTAGE_FACE_disk32: sum:uint32; CalcSum:int32 transient->0; Vertex:uint16[4] where Vertex[3] is material index; lpTexLink:ptr32 token; VectNormal:int16[4]
element_layout_notes.smTEXLINK_disk32: u float[3]; v float[3]; hTexture ptr32 (non-authoritative runtime material texture address); NextTex ptr32 relation token
element_layout_notes.smLIGHT3D: type,x,y,z,Range int32; r,g,b int16; 2 bytes pad

layout: area-list stream in y-major then x-major order for cells marked present

area_stream.recommended_current_encoding: for each present StageArea[x][y]: int32 serializedLength followed by uint32[serializedLength]
area_stream.list_semantics: first uint32 equals serializedLength-1; remaining values are face indices
area_stream.compatibility: modern loader accepts legacy WORD lists or DWORD lists; current writer emits DWORD
area_stream.legacy_bug_note: old writer wrote WORD payload while old loader read DWORD; current compatibility parser tolerates both

header_offset_quirk: For stage files MatFilePoint is set to 556 and First_ObjInfoPoint to 556+materialBytes even though the stage disk block is physically written between header and material. Runtime stage loader reads sequentially and does not seek via these offsets. Tool should reproduce source writer semantics for compatibility.
validation: material index Vertex[3] valid when material group exists
texture tokens resolve within link array
area first word count matches list length and all face indices valid
